content: Stand-up moved to 9:45 tomorrow, bring the sprint board and the release checklist.
Performance review next Thursday, collect examples of the migration project for my manager.
Pasted from Teams: "Please submit your timesheets by Friday noon, late entries will roll into next month's payroll."
Reply-all storm again, forty people asking to be removed from the list.
Flights to Edinburgh booked for the second weekend of May, hand luggage only.
Packing: passport, charger, travel adapter, sun cream, swimming shorts, paperback.
Photo: sunrise over the harbour in Split, the ferry already boarding.
Check the visa rules for Vietnam before booking anything, it may need an e-visa.
Hay fever is awful this week, ask the pharmacist about non-drowsy tablets.
Eye test on Monday at 4, my glasses have been blurry for weeks.
Appointment letter: "Please attend the outpatient clinic on 3 June at 10:20, bring your referral and medication list."
Sleep tracker says four hours of deep sleep, cut the late coffee and screens after ten.
Set up a standing order for the holiday fund, fifty pounds on the first of each month.
Compare the home insurance renewal quote with two other providers before it auto-renews.
From the bank: "Your overdraft limit will reduce to 250 from 1 August. No action is needed unless you wish to discuss alternatives."
My savings account earns less interest per year than a coffee costs.
Finished Piranesi in two sittings, the House of statues is stuck in my head.
Next on the shelf: Middlemarch, The Dispossessed, Tomorrow and Tomorrow and Tomorrow.
Photo of the bookshop window, a stack of orange Penguin classics.
Highlighted a line in Deep Work: shallow tasks expand to fill the day.
Boiler pressure dropped again, top up the loop and bleed the radiator in the spare room.
Hardware shop: wall plugs, filler, white emulsion, masking tape, a spirit level.
Pic: the new shelves going up in the alcove, still need a second coat.
Gutters are full of leaves, borrow the ladder on Saturday before the rain.
Swim session, 30 lengths front crawl then drills with the pull buoy.
Overhead press stalled at 40kg, drop the weight and add a set of lateral raises.
From the trainer: "Foam roll your calves and hips for five minutes after every lift, and eat protein within an hour."
Leg day is the only day the stairs are my enemy.
Tried the no-knead focaccia, dimpled with rosemary and flaky salt, a keeper.
Taco night: tortillas, black beans, lime, avocado, pickled onion, coriander.
Picture of the lasagne, the top went properly golden this time.
Stock from the chicken carcass, simmer three hours and freeze in cups.
Watched Parasite again, the stairs sequence hits even harder the second time.
Queue: Aftersun, The Bear season three, Shogun, Anatomy of a Fall.
The finale of Succession was perfect, that last shot of the two siblings on the sofa.
Screenshot of the poster for Dune Part Two, the sandworm in profile.
Mum's seventieth in July, plan a surprise lunch with the cousins and ask Aunt Jo to keep it quiet.
Parents' evening on Wednesday, ask about Maya's reading and the swimming lessons.
Photo: Dad and Leo building the tent in the garden, neither reading the instructions.
Call Grandma on Sunday, she wants the recipe for the apple cake.
Seminar reading for Thursday: two chapters on game theory and the problem set.
Dissertation proposal due in three weeks, book a supervisor meeting this week.
From the module page: "The coursework counts for 40 percent. Submit a single PDF through the portal before 17:00."
Revision plan: statistics on Monday, organic chemistry Tuesday, past papers Wednesday.
MOT due next month, tyres are close to the legal limit so price a new pair.
Warning light for tyre pressure came on, check all four with the garage gauge.
Service invoice: "Oil and filter change, brake fluid flush, wiper blades replaced. Next service due at 30,000 miles."
The satnav insisted on a left turn into a lake.
